purpose: Classify InterSol digital-asset maturity without conflating semantic/digital completeness with engineering approval, construction readiness or as-built state.
hard_boundaries: No digital-completeness statement may be represented as construction approval.
No as-built/live-twin state without physical commissioning evidence.
No structural, blast, fire, electrical, hydraulic, gas or security rating inferred from owner intent.
Site-neutral/redeployable architecture is preserved until site-specific binding evidence is accepted.
